tasks.short: Write research proposals and grant applications

steps.what: Read the actual funding call and verify the research question, eligibility, methods, team contribution, cost assumptions and permitted commitments with their real owners.

Populate repeated applicant, project, work-package and budget-reference fields in the application document {DOCS}; native templates reuse verified fields while retaining checking of call-specific requirements and cost-source versions.

Write research proposals or grant applications for submission to external bodies in {DOCS}; after native field reuse, draft study-specific prose from the biostatistician's explicit methods and actual evidence, retaining scientific authorship and revision.

loop.purpose: Draft explanations of an explicit research design without inventing evidence or commitments
loop.input: Permitted original sources, chosen methods, verified requirements and populated proposal structure
loop.output: Source-linked proposal prose with unresolved questions marked
loop.check: Biostatistician verifies scientific meaning, feasibility, sources and every proposed commitment in s4
loop.stop: At most two drafts; unsupported claims or unresolved design choices return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cover repeated fields but not study-specific explanation; manual writing remains the fallback

steps.what: Review and correct the completed proposal against original research evidence, call rules and actual authorised commitments; verify methods, costs, team permissions, final version and external destination.
Save the exact checked final proposal package in {DOCS}.
Send the exact checked proposal package to the external body through the grant-submission system {OTHER}, only within the biostatistician's actual submission mandate.

tasks.design: Test native application fields and {DOCS} templates first. Use a bounded prose draft only for explicit scientific content, then retain full source, feasibility and commitment checks before separate save and submission actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each call mixes repeated fields with a new scientific argument.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled source reuse and bounded drafting can reduce assembly without claiming better research judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Showing that the proposed study is feasible, useful and properly resourced.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician owns the methods and refuses unsupported promises.

ambition.what: No extra grant volume or funding success is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated assembly leaves more attention for design weaknesses; submission rights do not expand.

reach.learn: Tie proposed methods to feasible recruitment and actual evidence.

evidence.claim: Templates and source-bounded drafts can assist proposal assembly while scientific and commitment checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary: a proposal the biostatistician is actually authorised to write and submit. Required institutional permissions and cost evidence must be obtained and checked in s1/s4; no automated funding acceptance, contract or payment is included.

The funder produces eligibility, required fields, limits and submission destination. Research and cost owners supply methods, team roles, work packages, resources and actual cost versions. The biostatistician manually resolves missing evidence in the retained source work; no completed clean application is supplied free.
Confidential proposals use only a permitted drafting environment; if none exists use native fields and manual prose. Native configuration is tried before custom development.
The normal completed-proposal check in s4 binds each requested save/send gate with no added self-approval ceremony. Changes to contents, costs, permissions or destination invalidate it.
Shares and cuts are E1 scenario estimates, not measured institutional baselines.
unknowns: Actual submission mandate and required institutional approvals
Permitted drafting environment and current application templates
research_questions: Which repeated fields and prose passages consume active effort on comparable applications?

already_counted.description: Source elicitation, field checks, scientific drafting, complete review and final actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain call templates, source checks and bounded drafting instructions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final proposal package and internal record checked in s4
Exact proposal, authorised commitments and funder destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 21.25 less 3 upkeep yields net 18.25 for repeated assembly and supportable prose. Novel calls or rejected drafts can yield no net gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Elicit and verify biological data entities, identifiers, measurements, units, provenance, permitted use, access roles, retention and expected changes with actual data owners.
Design the biological database schema, keys, relationships, validation rules and change strategy, resolving conflicting definitions and deciding how missing and repeated observations are represented.

Build or maintain the specified database structures and validation definitions in a development copy of the database management software {OTHER}; native schema and migration tools reuse verified definitions while retaining source mapping and exceptional changes.

Test candidate structures and migrations against actual representative data and expected results, checking referential integrity, units, missingness, permissions, rollback and preservation of source records.
Write the change record and check the completed schema, migration, test evidence, rollback, authorised access and exact target database version before retaining or applying the package.
Save the exact checked database release package and change record in the controlled repository {DOCS}.
Apply the exact checked migration or schema change to the authorised biological database in {OTHER}, retaining the existing audit trail and without silently rewriting investigator source data.

tasks.design: Test native database schema, migration and validation facilities in {OTHER} before building a new records app. Reuse explicit definitions, keep biological meaning and test design human, and separate the final repository save from applying the checked database change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Biological identifiers and measurement meanings vary across sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native schema and migration tools can reuse specified structures without guessing those meanings.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving valid interpretation and source provenance across changes.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician resolves scientific definitions and determines whether migration evidence is adequate.

ambition.what: No additional dataset or access permission is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated schema setup leaves more time for data-definition and migration risks.

reach.learn: Validate keys, permissions, rollback and controlled schema evolution.

evidence.claim: Native database schema and migration facilities can reuse explicit definitions while human review remains necessary for biological meaning and access.

assumptions: Boundary: the biostatistician's authorised database-design and maintenance work, including development, actual validation, documentation and release. A separate administrator's work earns no saving; if deployment requires that role its real handoff effort must be measured before adopting this estimate.

Data owners supply entity IDs, specimen or subject links, variables, units, allowed values, missingness, provenance and permitted access. Actual examples are checked in s1; uncertain mappings are manually resolved in s1-s3, not supplied as a free clean schema.

Native configuration is tested first. Existing database execution and save runtime earn no labour saving; only repeated active schema construction is reduced. Unusual migrations stay manually developed and tested.

The completed-package check in s5 binds separate requested repository-save and database-change gates without extra approval labour. Any schema, data mapping, access or target-version change invalidates both.
Shares and reductions are illustrative E1 estimates; requirements depend on the actual research setting and national rules.
unknowns: Actual release authority and database tool features
Required independent validation and data-owner permissions
research_questions: Which database definitions recur without a change in biological meaning?

already_counted.description: Requirements, schema judgement, mapping exceptions, actual testing, change record and release remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable schema definitions, migration checks and access mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact schema, tests and change record checked in s5
Exact tested migration, permissions, rollback and target database version checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 less 2.5 upkeep yields net 12.5 when schema construction repeats. Already-generated schemas or bespoke migrations may yield no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check the actual survey protocol, participant eligibility and consent, question version, capture permissions and observation conditions before collecting data.

Collect data through surveys or experimentation by conducting the actual authorised survey interaction, clarifying questions without leading the participant and observing actual responses and collection conditions.

Record the actual responses and observation conditions in the survey capture software {OTHER}; native forms reuse the verified survey and visit identifiers and enforce allowed fields while the biostatistician enters and checks the real answers, missingness and corrections.
Save the exact checked response record to the authorised restricted survey dataset in {OTHER}, preserving actual collection time and correction history.

tasks.design: Configure native survey forms in {OTHER} before introducing another capture application. Keep the actual interaction and response entry human; reduce repeated survey metadata entry and field repair, then save the checked actual record separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated capture fields coexist with human-dependent collection quality.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse verified visit identifiers and validate explicit allowed fields.
tasks.still_hard: Consent, response meaning, nonresponse and collection conditions cannot be inferred from a complete form.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician recognises misleading or incomplete collection and preserves actual observations.

ambition.what: No additional participant group or collection volume is claimed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated metadata entry leaves more attention to collection quality; consent and access responsibilities remain.

reach.learn: Avoid leading questions and distinguish nonresponse from zero.

evidence.claim: Native structured forms can reuse known identifiers and validate explicit field types while actual response capture remains human work.

assumptions: Boundary: the survey branch of this OR task, from collection readiness through actual response recording. Experimental instrumentation needs its own measured design; no physical experiment time is removed.

Study owners supply protocol and question version, participant/visit identifiers, allowed answer codes and consent requirements. The biostatistician verifies these in s1 and records actual participant answers in s3; unstructured answers are manually entered and checked, not auto-inferred.

s2 and s3 may alternate question by question; each answer exists before it is recorded. Recording labour is separate from interaction and counted only in s3; participant effort is not transferred into a claimed role saving.

The ordinary completed-response check in s3 supplies the requested save gate. Edits or changed visit identity invalidate it with no extra approval stage; no scheduled visit is treated as completed collection.
Shares and metadata reductions are E1 scenarios, not measured baselines. Existing automatic capture earns no additional saving.
unknowns: Whether identifiers and answer validation are already configured
Actual collection mode and consent requirements
research_questions: Is repeated metadata and field repair a real burden in current capture?

already_counted.description: Readiness, actual interaction, response entry, meaning checks, corrections and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain permitted form versions, validation rules and access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact answers, observation conditions and participant/visit record checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 8.4 less 1.5 upkeep yields net 6.9 when repeated metadata entry and explicit field repair exist. An already-configured capture form yields no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply results to biological theory and new research

steps.what: Find and verify the actual research or simulation results, assumptions, biological context and relevant original studies; native linked result and reference views in {OTHER} reduce repeated navigation while complete scientific assessment remains.

Apply research or simulation results to extend biological theory or recommend new research projects, assessing alternative explanations, mechanistic plausibility, model limits and what a proposed study could actually distinguish.
outputs: reasoned theoretical implications and research options

steps.what: Discuss the proposed biological explanation and research options with domain researchers, challenge unsupported mechanisms and distinguish a statistical pattern from evidence sufficient to justify a new project.
inputs: reasoned theoretical implications and research options

steps.what: Write the actual recommendation note in {DOCS}, including evidence references, uncertainty, competing explanations and the proposed discriminating research, and check the completed meaning and version against the original evidence.
Save the exact checked theory and research note in {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Test native result and reference links in the scientific analysis and literature tools {OTHER}. Retain theory development, domain critique and the actual recommendation note; no model is credited with generating a valid biological explanation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific extensions require evidence beyond a plausible statistical pattern.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled source and result links can make the relevant evidence easier to revisit.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a useful mechanistic hypothesis from an attractive story.
tasks.human_edge: The biostatistician and domain researchers challenge the proposed explanation and design an informative next study.

ambition.what: No new theory or funded research programme is promised.

tasks.altitude: Less source navigation leaves more attention for competing explanations; project approval rights do not expand.

reach.learn: Specify observations that distinguish competing models.

evidence.claim: Native reference and result links support evidence retrieval without establishing theoretical validity.

assumptions: Boundary: applying existing actual research results to a theory or project recommendation. Original simulation execution, grant writing and external publication are distinct tasks; none receives duplicated saving here.

Research producers supply output IDs, parameter assumptions, populations, uncertainty and method versions; original sources supply biological context. The biostatistician checks these in s1 and manually seeks missing context; no prepared synthesis is free.

Existing domain discussion and actual recommendation writing are retained separately. The ordinary completed-note check in s4 supplies the requested save gate without extra approval labour; changes invalidate it.
Shares and reductions are E1 scenarios, not measured baselines. Native source linking is tested before custom code; no unvalidated hypothesis generation is automated.
unknowns: Actual scientific review and project-approval arrangements
research_questions: Does repeated evidence navigation consume meaningful active time?

already_counted.description: Source verification, theoretical reasoning, actual critique, note writing and save remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact evidence-linked recommendation and record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 7 less 1 upkeep yields net 6 where repeated evidence navigation exists. Already-linked sources or predominantly novel theoretical work yield no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Structured reuse reduces some proposal, database and data-capture repetition; scientific meaning, consent and final actions stay accountable.
reach: Learn controlled database migration and scientific hypothesis discrimination.
role.ambitious_version: Use reliable source and database preparation to spend more time testing whether proposed research can distinguish competing explanations.
